question: What is the simplified value of: (0.01404)/(24²+6²-144)
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Solve the denominator directly: 24² + 6² − 144 = 576 + 36 − 144 = 468. Convert the decimal numerator to an integer with a negative power of 10: 0.01404 = 1404 × 10−⁵. Divide the converted numerator by the denominator: 1404 ÷ 468 = 3. Combine with the power of 10 to get the final result: 3 × 10−⁵. **∴ The correct answer is 3 × 10−⁵.**
